$comment: Stored as the value of ocr_settings.config (JSON column) in your existing OCR settings table. ocr_settings.engine picks which sub-object under `providers` is active. Keep ALL provider configs stored simultaneously so switching engines in the UI doesn't lose the other providers' saved settings.

google_cloud_vision.note: Uses GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS on the server. No client-exposed key.

google_document_ai.note: Service account JSON lives only in GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS on the server, never sent to the browser.

mathpix.note: Used as a secondary pass for math-only crops, not full pages.

routing.$comment: How ingestion decides which engine handles which crop
